guide.hooks_desc: The hooks you can import from the package. Prefer them over writing the same thing yourself — a matchMedia listener, textarea height math, sort state. The import line, the signature and the example under each hook are generated from the source (JSDoc), so they match the installed version.
guide.hooks_group_responsive_desc: Read the viewport in JavaScript. For layout, prefer CSS (the breakpoint tokens and container queries); use these only when the rendered structure itself has to change.
guide.hooks_group_feedback_desc: Show a message from an event handler. Each one needs its provider once near the root of the app, and throws when called outside it.
guide.hooks_use_media_query: Track whether a CSS media query currently matches. Before the first client render it returns the default value you pass (false if omitted), so server and client render the same markup.
guide.hooks_use_breakpoint: The name of the largest breakpoint the viewport currently reaches (xs, sm, md, lg, xl). Until the component mounts it returns the smallest one.
guide.hooks_use_breakpoint_up: Whether the viewport is at or above the named breakpoint. The JavaScript counterpart of the SCSS up() mixin.
guide.hooks_use_breakpoint_down: Whether the viewport is below the named breakpoint. The JavaScript counterpart of the SCSS down() mixin, and of HamburgerMenu's visibleBelow.
guide.hooks_use_toast: Show a short message that dismisses itself — a one-off confirmation of what the user just did. For a state that stays true (a limit, an outage), render an inline Alert instead. Needs ToastProvider.
guide.hooks_use_snackbar: Show a single message bar at the edge of the screen. Showing a new message replaces the current one. Suits a message that carries one action, such as Undo. Needs SnackbarProvider.
guide.hooks_use_notification: Show a notification card in a corner of the screen. Notifications stack and suit events that happened elsewhere (a finished export, a new comment). Needs NotificationProvider.
guide.hooks_use_table_sort: Sort rows on the client for Table. Activating the same column cycles ascending, descending and unsorted. For server-side sorting, keep the state yourself and use onSortChange.
guide.hooks_use_auto_resize: Grow a textarea with its content up to a number of rows, then scroll. Textarea and PromptInput already do this — use the hook only for a textarea you render yourself.
guide.hooks_use_wim: Read the theme, density, locale and preset from the nearest WimProvider (or from the document when there is none).
guide.hooks_use_announce: Announce the result of an action to screen readers ("Saved", "3 results"). Render the returned region once and keep it rendered from the first paint, then call announce. This is the pattern WIM UI verified with a real screen reader: inserting a new status element together with its text is often not read. Components such as Toast, Kanban and Transfer already announce their own results.
guide.hooks_use_confirm: Ask the user to confirm an action and wait for the answer: await confirm() resolves to true or false. Use it before an action that cannot be undone. Needs ConfirmProvider.
